title: Data Engineer
description: Build and maintain batch and streaming pipelines that move data from product databases into our lakehouse. You will own ingestion, transformation, and data quality checks, and work with analysts to model tables for reporting.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Lead the design of our data platform: Kafka-based event streaming, Delta Lake storage, and dbt transformations. Mentor junior engineers and set standards for data quality, lineage, and observability.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Take models from notebook to production. Build feature pipelines, training jobs, and low-latency inference services. Experience with model monitoring and retraining loops is essential.

title: AI Engineer (LLM Applications)
description: Design and ship LLM-powered features: retrieval-augmented generation over internal documents, evaluation harnesses, and prompt pipelines. You will work with vector databases and embedding models daily.

title: Backend Engineer
description: Build REST and event-driven services in Python for a high-traffic consumer app. Own APIs end to end: design, implementation, tests, observability. PostgreSQL and Redis experience required.

title: Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description: Develop scalable services in Node.js and TypeScript for our payments platform. You will work on API design, message queues, and database performance in a fast-moving team.

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Deliver features across a React front end and a Node.js back end. Collaborate with product and design, write tests, and ship weekly. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines is a plus.

title: DevOps Engineer
description: Own our CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes clusters, and infrastructure as code. Improve deployment reliability and observability across dozens of services.

title: Data Analyst
description: Turn product and business data into decisions. Write SQL, build dashboards, and partner with teams to define metrics. Python for analysis is a plus.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Model raw warehouse data into clean, tested, documented tables with dbt. Bridge data engineering and analytics, and own data quality for reporting.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Build the platform that trains, deploys, and monitors ML models: pipelines, feature store, model registry, and GPU infrastructure orchestration.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description: Design the storage, compute, and governance layers of our data platform. Delta Lake, Spark, and a strong opinion on data quality and lineage.

title: NLP Engineer
description: Build Arabic and English text pipelines: classification, entity extraction, and semantic search using transformer models and vector stores.

title: Software Engineer, Search
description: Improve relevance and latency of product search. Work with inverted indexes, embeddings, and hybrid ranking. Elasticsearch or OpenSearch experience required.

title: Cloud Engineer

title: Streaming Data Engineer
